meta.protocol: TLS 1.2 / OpenSSL s_server manually curated evaluation subset

parties.name: TLS client
parties.description: External TLS client and application peer implemented by the generator

parties.name: TLS server
parties.description: Real OpenSSL s_server implementing the TLS server and -www responder

channels.name: TLS TCP connection
channels.description: One TCP connection carrying a TLS 1.2 session

endpoint_sources.from: ctx.host supplied by the evaluation runtime
ctx.port supplied by the evaluation runtime

steps.name: send ClientHello
steps.condition: Initial TLS 1.2 ClientHello for a full ECDHE-RSA handshake: offer ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256 (0xc02f), supported groups (e.g. X25519/P-256), signature algorithms and null compression. Advertise no session resumption; use ctx.host/ctx.port.

steps.name: receive ServerHello
steps.condition: After the valid ClientHello, parse TLS 1.2 ServerHello and its selected cipher; handle record/handshake fragmentation and coalescing.

steps.name: receive Certificate
steps.condition: In a full authenticated handshake, receive the real server certificate chain. The local test fixture is self-signed; configure client trust explicitly for this local evaluation rather than requiring a public CA.

steps.name: receive ServerKeyExchange
steps.condition: For selected ECDHE-RSA cipher, receive server ephemeral key exchange parameters and signature; an installed TLS SDK may implement handshake cryptography.

steps.name: receive ServerHelloDone
steps.condition: Consume the complete server first flight through ServerHelloDone. If the trace stops here, cleanly close owned TCP resources; completing the handshake is not required for that trace.

steps.name: send ClientKeyExchange
steps.condition: Continue full ECDHE-RSA handshake using the negotiated group and actual server key exchange parameters. A Python ssl TLS 1.2 client may execute the selected handshake steps.

steps.name: send client ChangeCipherSpec
steps.condition: After client key exchange, activate negotiated client write keys.

steps.name: send client Finished
steps.condition: Send encrypted Finished with valid transcript-dependent verify_data; using an installed TLS implementation is allowed.

steps.name: receive server ChangeCipherSpec
steps.condition: After the valid client Finished, activate negotiated server read keys.

steps.name: receive server Finished
steps.condition: Verify real server Finished and establish TLS 1.2; do not replace this with detecting ServerHello alone.

steps.name: send HTTP request in ApplicationData
steps.condition: After handshake success, send an encrypted HTTP GET / HTTP/1.0 request with Host: localhost and a terminating empty line to the configured s_server -www service.

steps.name: receive HTTP response in ApplicationData
steps.condition: Decrypt and collect bounded HTTP response bytes; require an HTTP 200 status and nonempty body from s_server -www, not just a completed handshake.

steps.name: send client close_notify
steps.condition: On an established session send a real encrypted close_notify. In handshake-close initiate shutdown; in https-roundtrip reply to server shutdown. Bound shutdown waits and close all sockets.

steps.name: receive server close_notify
steps.condition: On an established session consume actual server close_notify; it may follow the HTTP response or respond to client shutdown. Use TLS SDK orderly shutdown semantics, not plain TCP EOF as proof.

steps.name: send ClientHello without a shared cipher
steps.condition: Negative test: send a structurally valid TLS 1.2 ClientHello offering ONLY TLS_RSA_WITH_NULL_MD5 (0x0001), which this default security configuration disables. Do not offer any other real cipher. Send bytes on the wire; local SDK cipher selection rejection is not server behavior.

steps.name: receive handshake_failure
steps.condition: For the no-shared-cipher ClientHello receive and validate a real TLS fatal alert (level 2, description 40 handshake_failure). Expected rejection is successful test behavior; handle it without an uncaught Python exception.

steps.name: send ClientHello with duplicate supported_groups
steps.condition: Negative test: construct otherwise valid TLS 1.2 ClientHello with supported_groups extension (type 10) repeated twice. Offer a valid ECDHE-RSA cipher and valid group contents, correct record/handshake/vector lengths. Actually transmit the duplicate extensions; do not stop at local SDK validation.

steps.name: receive illegal_parameter
steps.condition: For duplicate recognized supported_groups extensions, current OpenSSL ssl/statem/extensions.c rejects duplicates with fatal illegal_parameter (level 2, description 47). Receive and validate that actual TLS alert; expected rejection is successful test behavior.
